claim_summary: Agricultural prediction produces scores and rankings but not constrained acreage allocations
Crop planning is an operationally constrained portfolio problem
Predictive accuracy and downstream decision quality differ
Loss-CVaR has an atom-safe convex finite-scenario representation
Ordinal rankings do not identify cardinal allocations
Scalar tail dependence does not generally order acreage
Reversal regions may be disconnected or multiple
Information value is actionable and weak action-set monotonicity does not imply strict complementarity
Primary solves replay and solver diagnostics pass
Simulation convergence fails the frozen gate
Operating-margin and acreage top ranks disagree in 63 of 77 state-years
National ranks align in all nine crop-year comparisons
Lagged 2024 relative-yield ranks disagree in 22 of 25 states
Observed acreage optimality CVaR binding copula mechanism and causality are not identified
